about: Test vectors for pen-coder.ts (2draw.net worker/src/pocket/PEN-CODER.md). Bytes are hex.

ints: a channel table from `channels` ([name, contexts], ids in order); each symbol [s|u, channel, value, context] coded in order into newSink(coder); the sink's finish() must equal bytes[coder]; reading with newSource gives the values back.

strokes: table channelTable(penChannelSpec(extras)); new PenStrokeEncoder(sink, penStrokeChannels(ch, extras), flags); enc.stroke(S, grid) for each stroke in order; finish() must equal bytes. Decoding: PenStrokeDecoder with the same flags, dec.stroke(S[0][0]) per stroke gives each stroke back.
Never regenerate: these are the codings files on S3 use. A new coding appends cases.
